title: Medical Equipment Repairers
description: Test, adjust, or repair biomedical or electromedical equipment.

tasks.text: Test or calibrate components or equipment, following manufacturers' manuals and troubleshooting techniques, using hand tools, power tools, or measuring devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical system testing with hands-on instrumentation

dwas.name: Test mechanical systems to ensure proper functioning.
Calibrate equipment to specifications.

tasks.text: Perform preventive maintenance or service, such as cleaning, lubricating, or adjusting equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Inspect, test, or troubleshoot malfunctioning medical or related equipment, following manufacturers' specifications and using test and analysis instruments.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Keep records of maintenance, repair, and required updates of equipment.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Disassemble malfunctioning equipment and remove, repair, or replace defective parts, such as motors, clutches, or transformers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Install machine or equipment replacement parts.
Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Examine medical equipment or facility's structural environment and check for proper use of equipment to protect patients and staff from electrical or mechanical hazards and to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI reviews records; human observes physical procedures

dwas.name: Monitor work areas or procedures to ensure compliance with safety procedures.

tasks.text: Install medical equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment attachment

dwas.name: Install equipment attachments or components.

tasks.text: Test, evaluate, and classify excess or in-use medical equipment and determine serviceability, condition, and disposition, in accordance with regulations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Plan and carry out work assignments, using blueprints, schematic drawings, technical manuals, wiring diagrams, or liquid or air flow sheets, following prescribed regulations, directives, or other instructions as required.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Procedure drafting aided; context-specific validation human

dwas.name: Interpret blueprints, specifications, or diagrams to inform installation, development or operation activities.
Plan work procedures.

tasks.text: Study technical manuals or attend training sessions provided by equipment manufacturers to maintain current knowledge.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Explain or demonstrate correct operation or preventive maintenance of medical equipment to personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational training requires live human delivery

dwas.name: Train others in operational procedures.

tasks.text: Research catalogs or repair part lists to locate sources for repair parts, requisitioning parts and recording their receipt.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Repair shop equipment, metal furniture, or hospital equipment, including welding broken parts or replacing missing parts, or bring item into local shop for major repairs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual repair of worn mechanical parts

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Solder loose connections, using soldering iron.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering connections needs precise manual work

dwas.name: Solder parts or connections between parts.

tasks.text: Compute power and space requirements for installing medical, dental, or related equipment and install units to manufacturers' specifications.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Calculation from specs; human confirms field conditions

dwas.name: Calculate requirements for equipment installation or repair projects.

tasks.text: Evaluate technical specifications to identify equipment or systems best suited for intended use and possible purchase, based on specifications, user needs, or technical requirements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection needs site context and judgment

dwas.name: Determine types of equipment, tools, or materials needed for jobs.

tasks.text: Contribute expertise to develop medical maintenance standard operating procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Advice good; hands-on equipment context needs human

dwas.name: Advise others on issues related to repairs, installation, or equipment design.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Fabricate, dress down, or substitute parts or major new items to modify equipment to meet unique operational or research needs, working from job orders, sketches, modification orders, samples, or discussions with operating officials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Supervise or advise subordinate personnel.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Employee supervision is accountability-bearing human work

dwas.name: Supervise employees.

tasks.text: Make computations relating to load requirements of wiring or equipment, using algebraic expressions and standard formulas.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Calculation from specs; human confirms field conditions

dwas.name: Calculate requirements for equipment installation or repair projects.
